package jwt

import "testing"

func TestSecurityExpectedAudienceRequiresAll(t *testing.T) {
	expected := Expected{Audience: Audience{"required-a", "required-b"}}
	if err := (Claims{Audience: Audience{"required-a"}}).Validate(expected); err != ErrInvalidAudience {
		t.Errorf("one matching audience weakened ALL semantics: %v", err)
	}
	if err := (Claims{Audience: Audience{"required-b", "required-a", "extra"}}).Validate(expected); err != nil {
		t.Errorf("all required audiences rejected: %v", err)
	}
}
